originalTitle: Options volume erupts in retail trading favorites as Robinhood, Tesla surge
summary: Options traders are kicking off the historically worst month for stocks by piling on bullish bets on a handful of retail trading favorites.
content:
So much for the September seasonal doldrums.

Options traders are kicking off the historically worst month for stocks by piling on bullish bets on a handful of retail trading favorites that are known for big swings and speculative activity.

Trading volume was above average on Thursday in stocks like Robinhood Markets , Palantir Technologies and Elon Musk giants Tesla and SpaceX — which were the top- and fourth-most traded stocks by options volume respectively.

The trading flows look discernably bullish with calls outpacing puts by at least 2 to 1 in each. While each name has a stock-specific story, traders may also be taking advantage of steep drop-off in implied volatility both in the S&P 500 and single stocks as the Cboe Volatility Index (VIX) trades below 15.

Retail trader favorite and surging trading platform stock Robinhood is seeing the most outwardly bullish action of these four names in Thursday's session. Calls are trading more than twice as heavily as puts through midday, with nearly three times as many calls bought relative to puts. Put selling outweighs put buying in the name as well, signaling confidently bullish sentiment from traders on more than triple average daily trading volume.

Robinhood stock is suddenly positive on the year after Thursday's huge move higher, and within striking distance of a fresh year-to-date high.

A similarly outsized stock move higher in Palantir is translating to heightened options activity as well. The software stock finds itself inside the top 10 most traded single-stock options on nearly double the average daily volume. Traders are buying twice as many calls than puts, with more puts being sold than bought.

But it's all about Musk mania ahead of this evening's Tesla Cybercab event in Austin, Texas. Traders in both Tesla and SpaceX are buying twice as many calls than puts, with significantly more puts being sold than bought.

The action in SpaceX comes as the stock retakes the key $150 level, a price it hasn't closed above since early July. It also comes alongside a huge drop-off in volatility. SpaceX's current 30-day implied volatility is in just the 4th percentile, and about half its historical average since going public June 12.

"Bitcoin ripping is great for Robinhood and Snowflake was the catalyst for Palantir," said Charles Moon, a momentum trading specialist at Prosper Trading Academy. "Retail's getting aggressive because all they need is a reason to be. It's a good sign."
chineseTitle: 随着罗宾汉和特斯拉的飙升，期权交易量在零售交易中激增
chineseSummary: 期权交易员通过对少数零售交易热门股票进行看涨押注，开启了股市历史上最糟糕的一个月。
chineseContent:
九月的季节性低迷就到此为止。

期权交易员对一些以大幅波动和投机活动而闻名的零售交易热门股票进行看涨押注，开启了股市历史上最糟糕的一个月。

周四，Robinhood Markets、Palantir Technologies 和 Elon Musk 巨头特斯拉和 SpaceX 等股票的交易量高于平均水平，这些股票分别是期权交易量排名第一和第四的股票。

交易流量看起来明显看涨，看涨期权与看跌期权的比例至少为 2 比 1。虽然每个名字都有一个特定于股票的故事，但随着芝加哥期权交易所波动率指数 (VIX) 低于 15，交易者也可能会利用标准普尔 500 指数和个股隐含波动率急剧下降的机会。

零售交易员最喜爱且飙升的交易平台股票 Robinhood 在周四的交易中看到了这四个股票中最明显的看涨走势。截至中午，看涨期权的交易量是看跌期权的两倍多，看涨期权的买入量是看跌期权的近三倍。看跌期权的卖出量也超过了看跌期权的买入量，这表明交易员对每日平均交易量超过三倍的信心十足的看涨情绪。

在周四大幅上涨后，罗宾汉的股价在一年内突然出现积极迹象，距离今年迄今的新高已经很近了。

Palantir 股票的大幅上涨也意味着期权活动的增加。该软件股票跻身交易量最大的十大单一股票期权之列，其日交易量几乎是日均交易量的两倍。交易者买入的看涨期权数量是看跌期权的两倍，卖出的看跌期权多于买入的看跌期权。

但这一切都是关于今晚在德克萨斯州奥斯汀举行的特斯拉 Cyber​​cab 活动之前马斯克的狂热。特斯拉和 SpaceX 的交易员购买的看涨期权数量是看跌期权的两倍，卖出的看跌期权远远多于买入的看跌期权。

SpaceX 采取行动之际，其股价重新回到了 150 美元的关键水平，自 7 月初以来，该公司的收盘价从未高于这一水平。与此同时，波动性也大幅下降。 SpaceX 目前的 30 天隐含波动率仅为 4%，约为 6 月 12 日上市以来历史平均水平的一半。

Prosper Trading Academy 的动量交易专家 Charles Moon 表示：“比特币的上涨对 Robinhood 来说非常有利，而 Snowflake 则是 Palantir 的催化剂。” “零售业变得越来越激进，因为他们所需要的只是一个这样做的理由。这是一个好兆头。”
whyItMatters: 这条信息属于财经市场信号，适合用于观察利率、汇率、股债商品、金融机构和宏观政策变化。
